ruleDefinitions.name: User Couldn't Call a Privileged Service 'LsaRegisterLogonProcess'
ruleDefinitions.description: The 'LsaRegisterLogonProcess' function verifies that the application making the function call is a logon process by checking that it has the SeTcbPrivilege privilege set. Possible Rubeus tries to get a handle to LSA. Note: Unmapped fields: Service, Keywords
